description: Search The Wiley Rule's worldwide literature index: a catalog of published studies on kratom/7-OH, vapes and nicotine analogs, synthetic cannabinoids and cathinones, nitazenes and fentanyl analogs, hemp-derived cannabinoids, new psychoactive substances, tianeptine and supplement adulteration, drawn from Europe PMC (all of PubMed) with author countries from OpenAlex. Indexed, not reviewed: this returns metadata and links only, and inclusion does not mean The Wiley Rule has read or endorsed a study. Reviewed summaries are in the smaller research library (search_research).

country.description: Optional two-letter author-country code, e.g. US, GB, TH

query.description: Keywords in title, authors or journal, e.g. 'metals disposable' or 'nitazene potency'

name: search_world_literature
title: Search all published studies worldwide (index)
